name: Vehicle
description: Store vehicle information associated with parking violations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle record

fields.name: licensePlate
fields.description: Vehicle license plate number

fields.name: state
fields.description: State of vehicle registration (e.g., CA, NY, TX)

fields.name: make
fields.description: Vehicle manufacturer (e.g., Toyota, Ford, Honda)

fields.name: model
fields.description: Vehicle model name

fields.name: color
fields.description: Primary color of the vehicle

fields.name: year
fields.description: Vehicle manufacturing year

constraints.uniqueLicensePlatePerState: Combination of licensePlate and state must be unique

name: Violator
description: Stores contact and account information for individuals who receive parking tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the violator

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the violator

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for notifications and correspondence

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary contact phone number

fields.name: address
fields.description: Mailing address for official notices

fields.name: totalOutstanding
fields.description: Total amount of unpaid fines in dollars

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Date when violator record was first created

relationships.description: A violator can own multiple vehicles

constraints.emailFormat: Must be a valid email address format
constraints.phoneFormat: Must be a valid phone number format

name: ViolationType
description: Define standardized parking violation categories and associated fines

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the violation type

fields.name: code
fields.description: Short violation code (e.g., EXP-MTR, NO-PARK, HNDCP)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the violation type

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the violation

fields.name: baseFineAmount
fields.description: Base fine amount in dollars for this violation

fields.name: severityLevel
fields.description: Severity classification (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this violation type is currently in use

name: User
description: Stores user accounts with authentication credentials, role assignments, and profile information for officers and administrators

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: username
fields.description: Unique username for login authentication

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role for access control (officer, administrator)

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address for notifications and communication

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is currently active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login for activity tracking

name: TicketPhoto
description: Store photographic evidence of parking violations

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the photo record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated parking ticket

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Storage path or URL to the uploaded image file

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Optional description or note about the photo

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the photo was uploaded

fields.name: uploadedBy
fields.description: Reference to the User who uploaded the photo

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the image file in bytes

fields.name: sequenceOrder
fields.description: Display order for multiple photos on the same ticket

relationships.description: Multiple photos can belong to one ticket
Each photo is uploaded by one user

name: AppealDocument
description: Store supporting documentation uploaded with appeal submissions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the appeal document

fields.name: appealId
fields.description: Reference to the associated appeal submission

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of document (e.g., receipt, photo, medical_record, witness_statement)

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileUrl
fields.description: Storage path or URL to access the uploaded document

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional description or notes about the document provided by the violator

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

name: AuditLog
description: Maintains comprehensive audit trail of all system actions and changes for compliance and accountability

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who performed the action

fields.name: actionType
fields.description: Type of action performed (e.g., TICKET_ISSUED, PAYMENT_PROCESSED, APPEAL_SUBMITTED, TICKET_MODIFIED, ADMIN_ACTION)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (e.g., Ticket, Payment, Appeal, Vehicle, User)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Unique identifier of the affected entity

fields.name: changes
fields.description: JSON object containing before/after values of modified fields and action details

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the action was performed

relationships.description: Links to the user who performed the action

constraints.retentionPolicy: Retain for minimum 7 years for compliance purposes

name: Payment
description: Records payment transactions for parking tickets including amount, method, status, and transaction details

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being paid

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Payment amount in currency units

fields.name: paymentMethod
fields.description: Method of payment (credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online)

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Current status of payment (pending, completed, failed, refunded)

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date and time when payment was processed

fields.name: gatewayResponse
fields.description: JSON string containing payment gateway response details

relationships.description: Links payment to the specific parking ticket

constraints.paymentMethod: Must be one of: credit_card, debit_card, cash, check, online
constraints.paymentStatus: Must be one of: pending, completed, failed, refunded

name: Notification
description: Track all notifications sent to violators and system users including delivery status and confirmation

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: recipientId
fields.description: ID of the recipient (Violator or User)

fields.name: recipientType
fields.description: Type of recipient (violator, user)

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (ticket_issued, payment_received, appeal_status, reminder, etc.)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Subject line of the notification

fields.name: content
fields.description: Full content/body of the notification message

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent

relationships.description: Links to violator when recipientType is violator
Links to user when recipientType is user

name: Appeal
description: Manages appeal submissions and review process for contested parking tickets

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the appeal

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parking ticket being appealed

fields.name: submissionDate
fields.description: Date and time when the appeal was submitted

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Detailed explanation for why the ticket is being appealed

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the appeal (pending, under_review, approved, denied)

fields.name: reviewerId
fields.description: Reference to the User assigned to review this appeal

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Final decision on the appeal (approved, denied, partially_approved)

fields.name: decisionNotes
fields.description: Reviewer's notes explaining the decision made on the appeal

relationships.description: Each appeal is associated with one parking ticket
Each appeal may be assigned to one reviewer
An appeal can have multiple supporting documents

name: ParkingTicket
description: Central entity capturing parking violation tickets with ticket number, violation details, fine amount, status, and complete lifecycle tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique ticket identifier

fields.name: ticketNumber
fields.description: Human-readable ticket number displayed on physical ticket

fields.name: violationTypeId
fields.description: Reference to the type of parking violation

fields.name: vehicleId
fields.description: Reference to the vehicle that received the ticket

fields.name: violatorId
fields.description: Reference to the registered owner or violator

fields.name: issuingOfficerId
fields.description: Reference to the officer who issued the ticket

fields.name: location
fields.description: Street address or location where violation occurred

fields.name: violationDateTime
fields.description: Date and time when the violation occurred

fields.name: fineAmount
fields.description: Original fine amount in dollars

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status (issued, paid, appealed, dismissed, overdue)

relationships.description: Ticket can have multiple payment records

constraints.validStatus: status must be one of: issued, paid, appealed, dismissed, overdue, cancelled
